note: The one home of the field guide's numbers, transcribed from station-layouts.md (Book: the guide spread, and the Book's face spread). Rectangles are [x, y, w, h] in screen pixels. Decided with the owner (2026-10-09): the guide is the Book's fold-out second spread, turned with ◀ ▶, and ← reads Library; eight chapters fit by narrower columns, never a scroll; one shared header panel per chapter, tinted by the species; the face is a guide-face master; the progress pips come in groups of five. Every field is bound to the M5 rules in prototypes/station/src/library.mjs (`derived`): nothing here is new state. The build draws only rectangles, text and 1 px lines; every other mark is a master placed 1:1 (masters).
level: species: the Book, the guide and the Library are about the species, filled in by every pod and mibi the player has read (fieldGuide). Pods and Habitat show one individual. station-layouts.md, The two levels

spreads.face: the Book's first spread: the species' face (or a portrait), its name, habit and clarity line, places, frame plate, stamp, tree and pinned wish
spreads.guide: the fold-out second spread: every chapter as a column, every trait as a cell with its pips, one detail band. Only when book(st, id).guide is not null (the species is found); a met species has no guide and no page-turn corner
spreads.turn: ▶ from the face spread's right-most target turns to the guide (300 ms page turn); ◀ from the guide's left-most column turns back. ◀ ▶ otherwise move the ring inside the spread

derived.book: book(st, id): status, guide, face, wish
derived.guide: fieldGuide(st, id, settings): chapters[] in frame order, each { id, name, sealed, traits[] { id, name, possible, found, unseen, more } }; complete; found; unseen
derived.pips: one pip per entry of trait.possible (possibleLooks: the frame's own player words); filled for each of trait.found, unseen for the rest. A shut sealed chapter (chapter.sealed) shows no traits, and its looks count as unseen
derived.plates: the detail band's plates: trait.found in the order of trait.possible, then one dotted "more?" slot when trait.more
derived.carriers: the mibis that carry a look: st.mibis of the species, not released, whose read chapters (m.read) hold the trait's chapter and whose chapterLooks(frame, chapter, m.genome) give the look for the trait. The same test wishCarriers applies to pinned looks, generalised to any look; the builder exports it from library.mjs as a pure function beside wishCarriers (lookCarriers(st, id, traitId, look)), reading the save only. Pods are not listed: they are pods, not yours to visit
derived.wishMark: wishOf(st, id)[trait.id]: the trait cell carries wish-mark-12, and the plate of that look carries it too
derived.wishAction: wishPinBlock(st, id, traitId, look) empty: ✓ Add to the wish (wishPin); the look already pinned: ✓ Take it off the wish (wishUnpin)
derived.notice: wishCarriers(st, id).pods not empty: "a pod carries your wish"; otherwise none
derived.visit: a carrier name: ✓ Visit {mibi}, the frame's jump book → habitat; on Habitat ← reads Home
derived.face: faceOf(st, id): null shows the guide face and the type line; a mibi id shows its portrait line (released when the mibi is released)
derived.visitTarget: visitTarget(st, id) for the face spread's ✓ Visit, unchanged; none: no ✓ cap
derived.tint: the species' first pod pigment, frame.pod.colourPair[0].pigment, through cross.json colours.pigmentChips to a palette name; a pigment not listed tints `mist`

foldout.note: one sheet across the gutter: the fold-out has no gutter and no cloth marker

face.note: the species' type, head and shoulders, painted from the type specimen at 128×112; never the halo, never scaled from the Book's 304×312 face

carried.note: each name is a focus target

sevenOrMore.moreNote: the dotted "more?" slot keeps the word whole: 56 wide, 40 tall, after the last plate

plates.slots: derived.plates; at most 11 today (ten looks and "more?")
plates.slice: trait-{SNN}-{trait}-{look}-56x56 or -40x40, rendered at its size
plates.open: the look the carried line names: the plate under the ring, or the last one it was on; on arrival the pinned look, else the first found. A 2 px `clay` rule 2 px under that plate

columns.moreThanEight: comes back to the UI designer; never a scroll
columns.x0: floor((512 - (pitch × n - 8) / 2) / 8) × 8: 40 for seven, 32 for eight, 240 for four

tint.lattice: inside the panel, from its own origin: every pixel with (px mod 4, py mod 4) = (0, 0) or (2, 2), for py from 3 to 78 and px from 1 to w - 2: one pixel in eight
tint.ruleNote: a 2 px band across the top inside the edge, in the full tint, the Library's inked clan-rule idiom

panel.master: placed 1:1 over the tint: the edge, the paper grain at low alpha and the chapter's ink emblem 40×40 at (w / 2 - 20, 8); its ground is open so the tint shows through; never recoloured

word.text: the chapter's name as the frame writes it, every word capitalised

sealed.master: guide-panel-sealed-{w}x80: slats and an 8×4 notch cut at the bottom centre

pips.widest: ten looks: 84 px, inside the 112 column

open.note: the trait shown in the detail band; the ring is the only highlight on top of it

cell.rows: at most six today (S09 Coat): the sixth row ends at y 504

faceSpread._note: the Book's first spread keeps its accepted layout (station-layouts.md, Book) with these changes
faceSpread.rightPage: the tabs and the trait rows go to the guide spread; the stamp label (832, 112), the family tree (800, 248) and the pinned wish (800, 424) stay
faceSpread.stamp: the type specimen's stamp (frame.typeSpecimen) until a portrait, then the portrayed mibi's

focus.initial: the first trait cell of the first chapter that is not sealed; the same after a jump into the guide

grid.up: the cell above; from the first row, the detail's first plate
grid.down: the cell below, stopping at the column's last
grid.left: the same row in the previous column that is not sealed, clamped to its last row; from the first column, the page turns back to the face spread
grid.right: the same row in the next column that is not sealed, clamped; from the last column, nothing

detail.left: the previous plate, then the carrier names from the last
detail.right: the next plate; from the last, nothing

masters._note: placed 1:1 at these sizes, never scaled or recoloured; the art director signs them. All new unless marked existing
masters.library-foldout-1008x504: the fold-out sheet: the boards and one page across the gutter, aged paper, no gutter, no marker
masters.guide-panel-{chapter}-128x80: one per chapter, shared by every species: coat, face, shape, legs-tail, movement, stamina, character, glow, charge (9). Edge, faint grain, the ink emblem 40×40 at (44, 8); open ground for the tint
masters.guide-panel-{chapter}-112x80: the same nine at the eight-chapter width, the emblem at (36, 8); painted at 112, never cut from the 128
masters.guide-panel-sealed-128x80: a shut panel: slats and an 8×4 notch at the bottom centre; no tint
masters.guide-face-{SNN}-128x112: one per species (S01 to S16): the type specimen, head and shoulders, painted at 128×112 on the plate's own ground with its mount
masters.wish-mark-12: 12×12: a pinned look, on a trait cell and its plate
masters.wish-mark-24: 24×24: the pinned wish panel's corner on the face spread
masters.mark-guide-16: 16×16 in `bone`, for chrome: after the species word on Habitat's card, the way to the guide
masters.trait-{SNN}-{trait}-{look}-56x56: look plates, rendered at 56 (the renderer's close-up, never cropped and enlarged)
masters.trait-{SNN}-{trait}-{look}-40x40: the same at 40, for seven slots or more

buildDraws: rect (the panel ground, the tint lattice pixel by pixel, the top band, found pips, the open edges, the open plate's rule), text and 1 px lines; nothing else
never: a digit or a count on the spread
a look the guide does not hold
a pod in the carried line
a scroll or a second row of columns
the halo as the guide's face
the tint on a sealed panel

strings.faceType: A typical {species}, not one of yours.
strings.facePortraitReleased: {mibi} sat for this, now in the wild.

elsewhere._note: the guide's doors on the individual's screens (station-layouts.md, The two levels); the numbers live in pods.json and station-layouts.md, Habitat
elsewhere.pods.overview: the figure is a focus target once the pod is identified: ✓ Open the guide, a jump to the Book's guide spread; ← there reads Library
elsewhere.habitat: the card's species word, with mark-guide-16, is a focus target: ✓ Open the guide, the same jump
